name: The Cold War in Fifty Years of Crises
description: Blockades, missiles, proxy wars and people power: the long standoff between two superpowers and how it ended without a shot between them.

checkpoints.name: The iron curtain falls
checkpoints.note: Wartime allies split over Europe. Germany is divided, the Berlin Blockade tests the West, and two rival camps take shape around the United States and the Soviet Union.

checkpoints.name: Hot spots and walls
checkpoints.note: War in Korea, revolt in Hungary and crisis at Suez show the limits of each side. The race into space begins with Sputnik, and in 1961 East Germany builds a wall through Berlin.

checkpoints.name: On the brink
checkpoints.note: The Cuban Missile Crisis brings the world close to nuclear war, then the United States sinks into Vietnam while the Soviet Union crushes the Prague Spring.

checkpoints.name: Détente and new wars
checkpoints.note: A thaw in relations gives way to renewed tension after the Soviet invasion of Afghanistan, while proxy wars and coups continue in Latin America, Africa and Asia.

checkpoints.name: The end of the Cold War
checkpoints.note: Mikhail Gorbachev's reforms open the door. In 1989 protests sweep Eastern Europe and the Berlin Wall falls, in 1990 Germany is reunited, and in 1991 the Soviet Union itself dissolves.
